lessons.title: My Weekend
lessons.titleNative: میرا ہفتہ وار چھٹی کا دن
lessons.context: A short story about how someone spent their weekend.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ ہفتے میرا ایک دن بہت خوبصورت تھا۔
paragraphs.en: Last week, one of my days was very beautiful.

paragraphs.urdu: صبح میں اپنے دوستوں کے ساتھ باغ گیا۔
paragraphs.en: In the morning I went to the garden with my friends.

paragraphs.urdu: ہم نے وہاں کھیل کھیلا اور بہت ہنسے۔
paragraphs.en: We played a game there and laughed a lot.

paragraphs.urdu: دوپہر کو ہم نے ایک اچھے ہوٹل میں کھانا کھایا۔
paragraphs.en: In the afternoon we ate food at a good restaurant.

paragraphs.urdu: شام کو میں گھر آیا اور اپنے خاندان کے ساتھ رہا۔
paragraphs.en: In the evening I came home and stayed with my family.

questions.question: Where did the person go in the morning?
What did they do at the park?
options: They played a game and laughed

questions.question: Where did they eat in the afternoon?
What did they do in the evening?

lessons.title: A Letter to a Friend
lessons.context: A short letter about future plans.

paragraphs.urdu: پیارے دوست، امید ہے تم ٹھیک ہو گے۔
paragraphs.en: Dear friend, I hope you are well.

paragraphs.urdu: میں اگلے مہینے ایک نئے شہر جاؤں گا۔
paragraphs.en: I will go to a new city next month.

paragraphs.urdu: وہاں میں ایک نئی نوکری شروع کروں گا۔
paragraphs.en: There I will start a new job.

paragraphs.urdu: مجھے تھوڑا ڈر بھی لگتا ہے اور خوشی بھی ہوتی ہے۔
paragraphs.en: I feel a little scared but also happy.

paragraphs.urdu: امید ہے کہ ہم جلد ملیں گے اور تمہیں سب کچھ بتاؤں گا۔
paragraphs.en: I hope we meet soon and I will tell you everything.

questions.question: What will the writer do next month?
What will they start there?
How does the writer feel?
options: A little scared and also happy

questions.question: What does the writer hope for?
options: To meet soon and tell everything

lessons.title: A Trip to the Village
lessons.context: A short past-tense story about a village trip.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ سال میں اپنے گاؤں گیا۔
paragraphs.en: Last year I went to my village.

paragraphs.urdu: وہاں میں اپنے دادا دادی کے ساتھ رہا۔
paragraphs.en: There I stayed with my grandparents.

paragraphs.urdu: ہم نے صبح کھیتوں میں سیر کی اور تازہ ہوا میں سانس لی۔
paragraphs.en: We walked in the fields in the morning and breathed fresh air.

paragraphs.urdu: رات کو ہم نے کھلے آسمان کے نیچے کھانا کھایا۔
paragraphs.en: At night we ate food under the open sky.

paragraphs.urdu: گاؤں کا سفر میری زندگی کی ایک اچھی یاد ہو گیا۔
paragraphs.en: The village trip became a good memory of my life.

questions.question: When did the writer go to the village?
Who did they spend time with?
What did they do in the morning?
What did the village trip become?

lessons.title: My First Day at a New Job
lessons.context: A short past-tense story about starting a new job.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ مہینے میں نے ایک نئی نوکری شروع کی۔
paragraphs.en: Last month I started a new job.

paragraphs.urdu: پہلے دن مجھے تھوڑا ڈر لگا کیونکہ سب لوگ نئے تھے۔
paragraphs.en: On the first day I felt a little scared because everyone was new.

paragraphs.urdu: دفتر میں مجھے ہر چیز کے بارے میں بتایا گیا۔
paragraphs.en: In the office, I was told about everything.

paragraphs.urdu: دوپہر تک میں نے کچھ نئے دوست بنا لیے۔
paragraphs.en: By afternoon I had made some new friends.

paragraphs.urdu: اب مجھے یہ نوکری بہت پسند ہے۔
paragraphs.en: Now I like this job a lot.

questions.question: When did the writer start the new job?
How did the writer feel on the first day?
How did the writer learn about everything?
options: Was told about it in the office
From a stranger on the street

questions.question: What happened by afternoon?

lessons.title: Learning to Cook
lessons.context: A short past-tense story about learning a new skill.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ ہفتے میری ماں نے مجھے کھانا پکانا سکھایا۔
paragraphs.en: Last week my mother taught me to cook.

paragraphs.urdu: پہلے میں نے سبزیاں کاٹیں اور مصالحہ تیار کیا۔
paragraphs.en: First I cut vegetables and prepared spices.

paragraphs.urdu: میری پہلی کوشش میں کھانا تھوڑا جل گیا۔
paragraphs.en: In my first attempt the food burned a little.

paragraphs.urdu: ماں نے مجھے صبر سے دوبارہ کوشش کرنے کو کہا۔
paragraphs.en: Mother told me to try again with patience.

paragraphs.urdu: آج میں اچھا کھانا پکا سکتا ہوں اور مجھے فخر محسوس ہوتا ہے۔
paragraphs.en: Today I can cook good food and I feel proud.

questions.question: Who taught the writer to cook?
What did the writer do first?
What happened in the first attempt?
How does the writer feel today?

lessons.title: A Visit to the Doctor
lessons.context: A short past-tense story about a doctor's visit.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ ہفتے مجھے بہت تیز بخار تھا۔
paragraphs.en: Last week I had a very high fever.

paragraphs.urdu: میں نے ڈاکٹر سے وقت لیا اور اس کے پاس گیا۔
paragraphs.en: I took an appointment with the doctor and went to him.

paragraphs.urdu: ڈاکٹر نے مجھ سے کئی سوال پوچھے اور مجھے دوائی دی۔
paragraphs.en: The doctor asked me several questions and gave me medicine.

paragraphs.urdu: اس نے کہا کہ مجھے ٹھنڈا پانی نہیں پینا چاہیے۔
paragraphs.en: He said that I should not drink cold water.

paragraphs.urdu: چند دنوں بعد میرا بخار ٹھیک ہو گیا۔
paragraphs.en: After a few days my fever got better.

questions.question: What was wrong with the writer last week?
What did the writer do?
options: Took an appointment with the doctor

questions.question: What did the doctor say not to drink?
What happened after a few days?

lessons.title: Planning a Trip
lessons.context: A short future-tense passage about trip planning.

paragraphs.urdu: اگلے مہینے میں اور میرے دوست ایک نئے شہر جائیں گے۔
paragraphs.en: Next month my friend and I will go to a new city.

paragraphs.urdu: ہم پہلے ٹکٹ خریدیں گے اور پھر ایک اچھا ہوٹل ڈھونڈیں گے۔
paragraphs.en: We will first buy tickets and then find a good hotel.

paragraphs.urdu: وہاں ہم پرانی عمارتیں دیکھیں گے اور نیا کھانا کھائیں گے۔
paragraphs.en: There we will see old buildings and eat new food.

paragraphs.urdu: ہم اپنے سفر کی تصویریں بھی لیں گے۔
paragraphs.en: We will also take pictures of our trip.

paragraphs.urdu: مجھے یقین ہے کہ یہ سفر بہت یادگار ہو گا۔
paragraphs.en: I am sure this trip will be very memorable.

questions.question: When will they go to a new city?
What will they do first?
What will they see there?
What does the writer believe about the trip?

lessons.title: My Favorite Season
lessons.context: A short comparative passage about seasons.

paragraphs.urdu: میرا پسندیدہ موسم بہار ہے۔
paragraphs.en: My favorite season is spring.

paragraphs.urdu: گرمی سے زیادہ بہار کا موسم خوشگوار ہوتا ہے۔
paragraphs.en: Spring's weather is more pleasant than summer.

paragraphs.urdu: بہار میں پھول کھلتے ہیں اور پرندے خوبصورت آوازیں نکالتے ہیں۔
paragraphs.en: In spring flowers bloom and birds make beautiful sounds.

paragraphs.urdu: میں اکثر بہار میں اپنے دوستوں کے ساتھ باہر رہتا ہوں۔
paragraphs.en: I often stay outside with my friends in spring.

paragraphs.urdu: جب بہار آتی ہے تو مجھے بہت خوشی محسوس ہوتی ہے۔
paragraphs.en: When spring comes I feel very happy.

questions.question: What is the writer's favorite season?
How is spring compared to summer?
What happens in spring?
How does the writer feel when spring comes?

lessons.title: A Surprise Visit
lessons.context: A short past-tense narrative about an unexpected visit.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ اتوار کو دروازے پر اچانک دستک ہوئی۔
paragraphs.en: Last Sunday there was a sudden knock at the door.

paragraphs.urdu: جب میں نے دروازہ کھولا تو میرا پرانا دوست وہاں کھڑا تھا۔
paragraphs.en: When I opened the door, my old friend was standing there.

paragraphs.urdu: میں بہت خوش ہوا کیونکہ ہم برسوں بعد ملے تھے۔
paragraphs.en: I was very happy because we were meeting after years.

paragraphs.urdu: ہم نے ساتھ چائے پی اور پرانی باتیں یاد کیں۔
paragraphs.en: We drank tea together and remembered old things.

paragraphs.urdu: یہ ملاقات میرے دن کی سب سے اچھی بات تھی۔
paragraphs.en: This meeting was the best thing about my day.

questions.question: What happened at the door last Sunday?
Who was standing there?
Why was the writer happy?
What did they do together?
options: Drank tea and remembered old things

lessons.title: Helping a Neighbor
lessons.context: A short past-tense story about kindness.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ ہفتے میرے بوڑھے پڑوسی کا سامان بہت بھاری تھا۔
paragraphs.en: Last week my old neighbor's luggage was very heavy.

paragraphs.urdu: میں نے اس کے پاس جا کر اس کی مدد کی۔
paragraphs.en: I went to him and helped him.

paragraphs.urdu: ہم نے مل کر سامان اس کے گھر تک لے گئے۔
paragraphs.en: Together we took the luggage to his house.

paragraphs.urdu: اس نے مجھے شکریہ کہا اور چائے دی۔
paragraphs.en: He thanked me and gave me tea.

paragraphs.urdu: چھوٹی مدد سے بھی کسی کا دن بہتر ہو سکتا ہے۔
paragraphs.en: Even small help can make someone's day better.

questions.question: What was heavy last week?
What did the writer do?
What did they do together?
options: Took the luggage to his house

questions.question: What does the passage say about small help?
options: It can make someone's day better

lessons.title: My New Hobby
lessons.context: A short passage about discovering a new hobby.

paragraphs.urdu: چند مہینے پہلے میں نے تصویریں بنانا شروع کیا۔
paragraphs.en: A few months ago I started painting.

paragraphs.urdu: پہلے میں نے سوچا کہ یہ مشکل ہو گا۔
paragraphs.en: At first I thought it would be difficult.

paragraphs.urdu: لیکن آہستہ آہستہ مجھے تصویریں بنانا بہت پسند آنے لگا۔
paragraphs.en: But slowly I began to like painting a lot.

paragraphs.urdu: اب ہر ہفتے میں کچھ گھنٹے اس کام کے لیے دیتا ہوں۔
paragraphs.en: Now every week I give some hours for this work.

paragraphs.urdu: یہ شوق مجھے سکون اور خوشی دیتا ہے۔
paragraphs.en: This hobby gives me peace and happiness.

questions.question: What did the writer start a few months ago?
What did the writer think at first?
What happens now every week?
options: The writer sets aside hours for painting

lessons.title: A Rainy Weekend at Home
lessons.titleNative: گھر پر بارش کا ہفتہ وار دن
lessons.context: A short past-tense story about a quiet weekend.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ ہفتے کے آخر میں مسلسل بارش ہو رہی تھی۔
paragraphs.en: Last weekend it was raining continuously.

paragraphs.urdu: میں باہر نہیں جا سکا، اس لیے میں گھر پر رہا۔
paragraphs.en: I could not go outside, so I stayed at home.

paragraphs.urdu: میں نے پرانی کتابیں پڑھیں اور گرم چائے پی۔
paragraphs.en: I read old books and drank hot tea.

paragraphs.urdu: شام کو میرے خاندان نے مل کر ایک فلم دیکھی۔
paragraphs.en: In the evening my family watched a movie together.

paragraphs.urdu: اگرچہ ہم گھر سے باہر نہیں گئے، پھر بھی یہ دن اچھا تھا۔
paragraphs.en: Even though we did not go outside the house, this day was still good.

questions.question: What was happening last weekend?
Why did the writer stay home?
What did the writer do at home?
options: Read old books and drank tea

questions.question: What did the family do in the evening?

lessons.title: Meeting an Old Friend
lessons.context: A short past-tense narrative about reconnecting with a friend.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ مہینے میں بازار میں اپنے پرانے اسکول کے دوست سے ملا۔
paragraphs.en: Last month I met my old school friend at the market.

paragraphs.urdu: پہلے تو میں نے اسے پہچانا نہیں کیونکہ بہت وقت گزر چکا تھا۔
paragraphs.en: At first I did not recognize him because a lot of time had passed.

paragraphs.urdu: جب اس نے اپنا نام بتایا تو مجھے بہت خوشی ہوئی۔
paragraphs.en: When he told his name I became very happy.

paragraphs.urdu: ہم نے ایک ساتھ بیٹھ کر پرانی یادیں یاد کیں۔
paragraphs.en: We sat together and remembered old memories.

paragraphs.urdu: ہم نے دوبارہ ملنے کا وعدہ کیا۔
paragraphs.en: We promised to meet again.

questions.question: Where did the writer meet the old friend?
Why did the writer not recognize him at first?
options: A lot of time had passed

questions.question: What did they do together?
What did they promise?

lessons.title: My Plans for Next Year
lessons.context: A short future-tense passage about upcoming plans.

paragraphs.urdu: اگلے سال میں کالج میں داخلہ حاصل کروں گا۔
paragraphs.en: Next year I will get admission in college.

paragraphs.urdu: میں سائنس پڑھوں گا کیونکہ مجھے یہ مضمون بہت پسند ہے۔
paragraphs.en: I will study science because I like this subject a lot.

paragraphs.urdu: میں نئے دوست بناؤں گا اور نئی چیزیں سیکھوں گا۔
paragraphs.en: I will make new friends and learn new things.

paragraphs.urdu: میرے والدین کو مجھ پر فخر ہو گا۔
paragraphs.en: My parents will be proud of me.

paragraphs.urdu: مجھے یقین ہے کہ اگلا سال میری زندگی کا اہم سال ہو گا۔
paragraphs.en: I am sure next year will be an important year of my life.

questions.question: What will the writer do next year?
What will the writer study?
What will the writer do at college?
options: Make new friends and learn new things

questions.question: How will the parents feel?

lessons.title: A Lesson I Learned
lessons.titleNative: ایک سبق جو میں نے سیکھا
lessons.context: A short reflective past-tense passage about a life lesson.

paragraphs.urdu: گزشتہ سال میں نے ایک بڑی غلطی کی۔
paragraphs.en: Last year I made a big mistake.

paragraphs.urdu: میں نے اپنے دوست کی بات پر یقین نہیں کیا اور وہ ناراض ہوا۔
paragraphs.en: I did not believe my friend's words and he became upset.

paragraphs.urdu: مجھے بعد میں سمجھ آیا کہ میں غلط تھا۔
paragraphs.en: I later understood that I was wrong.

paragraphs.urdu: میں نے اس سے معافی مانگی اور ہماری دوستی دوبارہ اچھی ہو گئی۔
paragraphs.en: I asked him for forgiveness and our friendship became good again.

paragraphs.urdu: اس واقعے نے مجھے سکھایا کہ ایماندار دوستوں پر ہمیشہ یقین کرنا چاہیے۔
paragraphs.en: This event taught me that one should always trust honest friends.

questions.question: What did the writer do last year?
What did the writer not do?
What did the writer do after understanding the mistake?
What did this event teach the writer?
